title: Plan an AI-assisted coding project
description: Inspect the starting state and break delivery into testable milestones.
accomplishes: Inspect the starting state and break delivery into testable milestones. Define bounded agent tasks, interfaces, review checkpoints and acceptance criteria. Identify security and data risks. Include a rollback approach and distinguish planning from execution or deployment.
prompt:
Act as a senior software engineer.

Task: Plan an AI-assisted coding project.

Input context:
- PROJECT: [PROJECT]
- STACK: [STACK]
- TEAM: [TEAM]
- DELIVERY CONSTRAINTS: [DELIVERY CONSTRAINTS]

Inspect the starting state and break delivery into testable milestones. Define bounded agent tasks, interfaces, review checkpoints and acceptance criteria. Identify security and data risks. Include a rollback approach and distinguish planning from execution or deployment.

Preserve existing work and data. Define acceptance criteria and relevant checks. Separate plans, simulations and executed actions. No deployment without approval.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Three-milestone delivery plan
First document routes and existing behaviour. Next implement one read-only flow with fixtures and tests. Finally connect the approved backend contract and verify failure handling. Review each diff before the next milestone. Keep secrets outside prompts and production writes out of local tests. Dates and effort remain estimates until the repository is inspected.
